title: The Truth About Solar Eclipse Darkness

scenes.text: During the August 12 eclipse over Spain, the sky turned pitch‑black for over two minutes
Many think a total eclipse makes the Sun disappear completely
scenes.label: Sun Vanishes Fully

scenes.text: Even at totality a thin solar corona remains visible, and scattered daylight still illuminates the landscape faintly
scenes.label: Corona Still Glows

scenes.text: The Sun’s outer atmosphere never truly goes dark
scenes.label: CORONA LIGHT

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Learn why a total solar eclipse never makes the Sun completely vanish and what the glowing corona really looks like. Follow for daily science!
